answer: Every new agent posts a slashable juniper stake before it can attest or grade. Independent peers then issue a violet voucher only after comparing the applicant's attestation graph and timing signature against the live set; colliding identities share one voucher and the later stake is burned. Only agents holding both a live juniper stake and a unique violet voucher may enter the earning garden. An attacker who wants N sybils must lock N separate stakes and still convince distinct peer cohorts to sign N uncorrelated vouchers, or lose those bonds to the jurors who flagged the collision.
